name: dev-server
description: Starts the project's server in /workspace at every boot of the sandbox, for the agent's own checks (a helper restarts it), and, with a port, a second time in a container of its own next to the sandbox: from the agent's checkout, restarted whenever a file changes, published as a button on the run's session. The sandbox itself publishes nothing; the agent's code never runs on the host, and the demo container gets none of your credentials unless you add claude-home to its plugins. Nothing configured → does nothing.

settings.label: Command
settings.description: Run in /workspace at every boot of the sandbox, and in the demo container when a port is set (there it must listen on 0.0.0.0). Empty: nothing is started.

settings.label: Demo port
settings.description: The port the command listens on: set, the command also runs in a demo container next to the sandbox, restarted on every change, published on this machine where the web UI listens and shown on the run's session. Needs agent-workspace. Empty: no demo container.

settings.label: Demo setup commands
settings.description: Shell commands run in the demo container alone, in /workspace, in order, before the command first starts: what the demo needs that the sandbox must not have (credentials of its own, seed data).

settings.label: Demo plugins
settings.description: Plugins whose share of the sandbox the demo container takes too, beyond the ones that declare themselves fit for it (upstream-proxy's routes, ca-certs, docker-cli's Docker daemon): claude-home gives it the run's copy of your ~/.claude, a real login for the agent's code. Only plugins enabled for the project.
